props.name: children
props.description: The content to search. Only its text is searched; the find bar never matches itself.

props.name: label
props.description: What the content is, for the field’s name — “Find in {label}”.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the find bar is showing. Omit to let the component manage it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the bar asks to open or close.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Where Ctrl/⌘+F opens this bar instead of the browser’s: only while focus is inside (`within`), anywhere on the page (`document`), or nowhere (`false`).
